notes.title: DEVLOG #6: COSMIC FEAR - PROGRESS UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Welcome back to another devlog for my upcoming game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306920/Cosmic_Fear/]Cosmic Fear[/url]. I’m thrilled to share some exciting updates on the progress as I continue to bring this Lovecraftian horror adventure to life. 

[previewyoutube=8QND2UhKSoU;full][/previewyoutube]
I've been crafting new environments that will take you deeper into the unknown. 
The latest environments are inspired by some of the eeriest corners of the universe, blending Lovecraftian horror with breathtakingly beautiful yet haunting landscapes. I’m paying close attention to every detail, from the creepy soundscapes to the dynamic lighting effects, to ensure that each environment feels unique and contributes to the overall atmosphere of dread.

Here's a sneak peek at what I’ve been working on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/c7e2f639436fc6c16665871734d04471c7f1098a.jpg[/img]
I’m excited for you to explore these new areas and uncover the secrets they hold.


In addition to the world building, I’m also working on the save system:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/95a12baf238c0f385012891dbc0557980ffb4091.jpg[/img]

[b]Join me on Youtube![/b]

I’m often live on my [url=https://www.youtube.com/@alessandroguzzo]Youtube channel[/url] where you can join me while I play games, as well as dive deep into game development discussions, share tips and tricks, and interact with you. It's a great way to stay connected, and I can't wait to see you there and chat with you all in real-time! 


Don't forget to grab the Cosmic Horror bundle on sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23128/Cosmic_Horror_Bundle/

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm!

notes.title: DEVLOG #2 - New game update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I hope you had a great 2024 start!

Here’s a quick update on the new game I’m working on, a first person horror adventure with Lovecraftian lore and extraterrestrial vibes. 

I’m currently working on a new map, an abandoned village which seems to be connected to an ancient legend around a factory not far from there. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/29d6bb961cfa9ef661485c2632c5d23d587cb009.jpg[/img]
Plot: You are a young archeology student and decide to spend a few weeks at your grandparents’ home to study for the exams. One day you find yourself investigating strange phenomena that occur only at a certain time of the year in a nearby forest. This time the episodes are weirder than usual and it looks like you're not the only one who's keeping an eye on them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/7a94a8719cd85cb3a60c73931b06b085d9005ebc.jpg[/img]
You'll explore different environments such as sinister forests, abandoned buildings and underground tunnels, where antique secrets will come to light after being buried for centuries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/f2cba8c1224e38c33a15b7a029f72db61d17da07.jpg[/img]

Like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099220/The_Alien_Cube/][b]The Alien Cube[/b][/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/568930/The_Land_of_Pain/][b]The Land of Pain[/b][/url], this is going to be a cosmic-horror game focused on story and mystery, with realistic graphics and an immersive atmosphere.
In this chilling adventure you will have to face the inevitability of fate while exploring disturbing places, finding clues and studying ancient mysteries.

To be up-to-date with the latest news follow me on my socials and on my [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GuzzoProductions]Steam developer page[/url].

Also, don’t forget that [b]The Land of Pain[/b] and [b]The Alien Cube[/b] are on sale right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23128/Cosmic_Horror_Bundle/

notes.title: Halloween Update & Developer Livestream
notes.notes:
[b]Steam Deck Compatibility[/b]

The Alien Cube has been updated to support Steam Deck.
You can delve into this Lovecraftian horror adventure wherever you are!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/2267b0f248f7e2977d5365a6a7262871c22bbcde.jpg[/img]

[b]Steam Cloud added[/b]

The Alien Cube now supports Steam Cloud so you can keep your savegames on your gaming devices!

[b]Halloween in-game Event[/b] 

The Alien Cube gets into the Halloween mood also this year. Get ready to explore the different areas of the game to find hidden pumpkins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/9de34df226733124cfd88b99e5021c9f4de1fadd.jpg[/img]

[b]Watch the developer play[/b]

This year’s Halloween Event I’m going to simulcast The Alien Cube to the store page here on Steam and my [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCyKtNyEy6CSV998TtyWfr0w]YouTube channel[/url] while chatting with you guys!
I’ll play the game and will talk about game’s development, future plans and my next project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/cfed5b622dcb05f5f30cda20a83af5900346423d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/75a7ec38a9ad3f45b2666344c70871c08b231273.jpg[/img]

Everyone is welcome, I’ll be happy to answer your questions ;)

The Alien Cube Livestream starts on October 26th at 8PM CEST.


If you want to be up-to-date with the latest news and events on my games, follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/GuzzoProds]Twitter [/url]and [url=https://www.instagram.com/guzzoproductions/?hl]Instagram[/url].

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
CHANGELOG:

-Various bugs fixed and improvements in all levels
-Performance improvements in Chapter 4 and 5
-Horse statuette puzzle improved
-English localization improved

SAVEGAMES WARNING: It may happen that some savegames may not be compatible with this new version, it that case the game will load the beginning of the chapter you were playing.


Thank you all for your feedback and your support!

Alessandro
